chunks: They said, "We have been sent to a sinful people."
ai.seo_question: Who said 'We have been sent to a sinful people' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Hud, this verse underscores the divine justice served upon the people of Lot, whose moral corruption necessitated the arrival of the angels. Shia exegesis often highlights this as a precursor to the specific mission of delivering Lot and his family, emphasizing that the 'criminals' (mujrimin) were targeted for their unique transgression of violating hospitality and engaging in illicit acts.
